### CVE-2003-0190
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2003-05-02 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 26: OpenSSH/PAM 3.6.1p1 - 'gossh.sh' Remote Users Ident (remote/linux, 2003-05-02, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 25: OpenSSH/PAM 3.6.1p1 - Remote Users Discovery Tool (remote/linux, 2003-04-30, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 3303: Portable OpenSSH 3.6.1p-PAM/4.1-SuSE - Timing Attack (remote/multiple, 2007-02-13, verified=1)

OpenSSH-portable (OpenSSH) 3.6.1p1 and earlier with PAM support enabled immediately sends an error message when a user does not exist, which allows remote attackers to determine valid usernames via a timing attack.
